provenance.tier_b_note: Tier B is physics-generated data. None exists. It is gated on our implementation of the classical synthesis reproducing Table 2's iterative column to MAE 0.5 deg or MRE 1.5 %, and that gate fails at MAE 1.66 deg / MRE 5.75 %. A generator carrying 5.75 % of its own error cannot train a surrogate to beat 3.74 %, so zero synthetic rows were written.
provenance.correction_note: Case 11 was recorded as theta = 37.4 in our original working sheet; Table 2 prints 37.04. A digit transposition, found by checking every row against the PDF, corrected in this dataset. The original sheet is kept unmodified at data/raw/ann_testing_original.csv.
provenance.derived_note: rc_mm = sqrt(C) * r_w is the cathode disc radius; Rc_mm = rc_mm / sin(theta) is the radius of curvature of the spherical cap. Both are exact algebra from eqs (2) and (4), flagged in derived_fields. Every other column is read from the paper.
